name: x2611_15210_thm1_2
original:
Let $m\geq 3$ be odd, and define $\rho_{m}>1$ and $\alpha_{m}>2$ by

 $\rho_{m}=\left(\frac{9^{2m}}{9+36\binom{2m}{m}}\right)^{1/(5(2m-1))},\qquad\alpha_{m}^{5}=12\alpha_{m}+8\rho_{m}.$ 

Then, for every $r\geq 1$ ,

(1.2)

 $\mathsf{s}_{2m}(C_{m}^{r})\ \geq\ \frac{m}{12e}\,\rho_{m}^{r}+1,\qquad\mathsf{s}(C_{2m}^{r})\ \geq\ \frac{m}{12e}\Bigl(\frac{2}{\alpha_{m}}\Bigr)^{4}\alpha_{m}^{r}+1.$ 

Moreover, $\rho_{m}\geq\rho_{3}=3^{6/25}=1.3016945937\ldots$ and hence
 $\alpha_{m}\geq\alpha_{3}=2.0341017978\ldots$ for all odd $m\geq 3$ , and

 $\lim_{\begin{subarray}{c}m\to\infty\\
m\text{ odd}\end{subarray}}\rho_{m}=(9/2)^{1/5}=1.3509600385\ldots,\qquad\lim_{\begin{subarray}{c}m\to\infty\\
m\text{ odd}\end{subarray}}\alpha_{m}=2.0394244419\ldots.$
type: ∀ (m : ℕ), 3 ≤ m → Odd m → 1 < Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m ∧ 2 < Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m) ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m) ^ 5 = 12 * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m) + 8 * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r → ↑m / (12 * Real.exp 1) * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m ^ r + 1 ≤ ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_15210_s (2 * m) (Fin r → ZMod m)) ∧ ↑m / (12 * Real.exp 1) * (2 / Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m)) ^ 4 * Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m) ^ r + 1 ≤ ↑(Mathlib2.x2611_15210_s (2 * m) (Fin r → ZMod (2 * m)))) ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho 3 = 3 ^ (6 / 25) ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho 3 ≤ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m ∧ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho 3) ≤ Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho m) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho (2 * k + 1)) Filter.atTop (nhds ((9 / 2) ^ (1 / 5))) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun k => Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_rho (2 * k + 1))) Filter.atTop (nhds (Mathlib2.x2611_15210_alpha ((9 / 2) ^ (1 / 5))))
